purpose: Task 4.1 fixture postconditions for future native observations; not execution results.
common: Read every fixture initialPublic assertion through Inspector (or tracked patchedPublic after patch).
Deserialize the current source and verify all preserved typed internal references; no unresolved __uuid__ or native-file link.
AssetDB staged URI, root UUID, importer and generated meta identity agree after settle.
Retain raw stage logs with zero new warning/error and exact Creator/candidate attribution; missing observation fails a case.

create: Create using the exact-version source/template recipe; read the root native type, Inspector fields and fresh AssetDB/meta UUID after import settles.
import: Import the staged exact-version source and freshly allocated sidecar identity; read native root type, importer, Inspector values and typed links.
inspect: Read all initialPublic pointers and require exactly the expected values, plus actual AssetDB root UUID and native root type.
query: Query staged URI and UUID; require exactly one registered root of the expected kind and typed content.
patch: Apply the named public Inspector patch; after save/refresh read all patchedPublic values and serializedPatchAssertions; root UUID, internal graph links and absent external references remain unchanged.
copy: Both roots expose identical tracked Inspector/typed content; destination root UUID differs; source raw source/meta digests and UUID remain unchanged; no orphan or duplicate registration.
move: Destination has the tracked Inspector/typed content and same UUID; old URI is absent from AssetDB, new URI resolves exactly once, meta UUID remains stable.
rename: New URI/display name verified separately; tracked content except importer-driven naming changes and all internal links remain stable; old URI absent and root UUID stable.
refresh: Reload source/meta and each tracked Inspector value after importer settles; same UUID and typed content, no stale registration or unresolved reference.
delete: Preflight rejects external dependents; after deletion source/meta and registered root UUID are absent, no own subasset residue, unrelated assets unchanged; raw settle/exit logs remain clean.

nativeExecution: not performed; Creator must not be launched in task 4.1
